Next, the average intensity of the HDR for each condition was derived in the following steps: (1) the single-trial epochs for each participant were averaged separately for each condition, and BOLD-intensity signal values within the averaged epochs were converted to percent signal change; (2) the waveforms for each voxel were correlated with an empirically derived hemodynamic function, 41 , 42 and t statistics were calculated for these correlation coefficients, providing whole-brain t maps in MNI space; and (3) the t maps were used to calculate an average t map across participants that was then thresholded using a false discovery rate (FDR) 43 of P < .001.
